name: Atlas (DRC, hydraulic)
summary: The hydraulic humanoid Boston Dynamics built for the DARPA Robotics Challenge and then developed for a decade of research. Seven DRC teams shared a common Atlas; a 2015 revision ('Atlas Unplugged') moved to onboard battery power. Later videos showed it running, jumping, doing backflips and parkour. Boston Dynamics retired the hydraulic Atlas in April 2024.
notable: Shared platform for the 2015 DARPA Robotics Challenge finals
